turns.spoken:
The question of who invented the telephone is a topic of long debate.

In 1876, he successfully patented his device and made the world's first intelligible telephone communication. However, there is also controversy about whether Bell stole the invention from Elisha Gray, who claimed to have made his own working prototype around the same time.
